bump#1.notes: single low thump with a short falling boing; clean tail by 0.31s

bump#0.notes: three scattered weak taps, -31 LUFS, no single clunk

zap#1.notes: bright crackle burst then short buzzy hum, ends 0.35s; playful not harsh

zap#0.notes: clipped crackle (true peak +2 dBTP), longer harsh tail

drown#1.notes: four quick rising bloops, bubbly gurgle, done by 0.5s

drown#0.notes: same bloop idea but six bloops and longer; drown-1 is tighter

lava#0.notes: short bright sizzle that fades out by 0.55s

lava#1.notes: similar sizzle but runs to the end of the clip, less of a fizzle-out

ice#0.notes: crisp crack then a smooth falling whistle, reads as crack-and-fall

ice#1.notes: crack, gap, then a very loud noisy whistle (-4.6 LUFS, clipped)

pickup#0.notes: fast rising sparkly glissando, ends cleanly at 0.39s

pickup#1.notes: rising sweep buried in noise, runs to the clip end

dot#1.notes: clean soft pop; played trimmed to the first pop (second pop cut in the mix)

dot#0.notes: two overlapping pops with a smeared tail

exit#3.notes: rising stepped xylophone arpeggio resolving on a held note: a real little jingle

exit#2.notes: two static tones after a click, no melody

exit#4.notes: two static tones, quiet (-29 LUFS), no melody

fail#2.notes: wobbly wah-wah that steps down to a low blip, sad but gentle, done by 0.4s

fail#1.notes: static buzzy chord, clipped, no descent

fail#4.notes: wah-wah wobble without a clear downward step, 0.72s

tile-pick#3.notes: single hollow plastic tock; played trimmed to the main click

tile-drop#0.notes: one firm clack at 0.1s; played trimmed to that click

tile-rotate#1.notes: even ratchet ticks; played trimmed to the first tick

tile-rotate#0.notes: irregular ratchet ticks; take 1 has a cleaner first tick

click#1.notes: single soft broadband pop, clean decay

click#0.notes: pop plus a stray click at the clip end

scan#1.notes: two rising chirps (boop-beep), clearly a little scanner

scan#0.notes: single rising tone, fine but take 1 reads more as a robot sensor

unlock#2.notes: ascending three-step bell arpeggio with sparkle, cheerful, done by 0.72s

unlock#1.notes: sparkle then static tone, no arpeggio

unlock#4.notes: mostly static chord after a short blip

fanfare#0.notes: clear multi-note toy fanfare with drum hits, triumphant, final note fades by 1.65s

fanfare#1.notes: busy noisy start then a long static tail; less melodic
